people.name: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
people.field: orientalist, Protestant theologian, and Biblical exegete

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.evidence: in 1820 he entered the University of Göttingen, where he studied with J. G. Eichhorn and T. C. Tychsen, specialising in oriental languages. At the close of his academic studies in 1823

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.role: professor extraordinarius in philosophy and lecturer in Old Testament exegesis
relations.evidence: in 1827 he became extraordinary professor there... in 1827 (the year of Eichhorn's death) he became professor extraordinarius in philosophy and lecturer in Old Testament exegesis.

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.evidence: In 1831 Heinrich Ewald was promoted to professor ordinarius in philosophy

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.evidence: in 1835, after Tychsen's death, he entered the faculty of theology, taking the chair of Oriental languages.

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.role: professor ordinarius in philosophy and theology
relations.evidence: Early in 1838 Ewald received a call to Tübingen, and there for upwards of ten years he held a chair as professor ordinarius, first in philosophy and afterwards, from 1841, in theology.

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.evidence: In 1848, he returned to his old position at Göttingen... War of 1866... he was therefore placed on the retired list

relations.subject: Georg Heinrich August Ewald
relations.evidence: the commencement of his bitter feud with F.C. Baur and the Tübingen school.

relations.subject: August Schleicher
relations.evidence: he taught many distinguished pupils, including August Schleicher, Ferdinand Hitzig, Eberhard Schrader, Theodor Noldeke, Diestel and Christian Friedrich August Dillmann.
